system.description:
You may use this skill if your sub class is Blacksmith, Weaponsmith, or Armorer.
You receive one item with an Item Rank that does not exceed your CR that has the [One-Handed] tag.
(SR2): The received item may have the [Two-Handed] tag.
(SR3): The received item may have the [Heavy Armor] [Medium Armor] or [Light Armor] tag.
(Connection: Merchant, Miner, Trader): Reduce the [Fate Point] cost of this skill to 1.

A feat that shows that you have the technology to create various weapons and armor.
